palette.notes: Perler-bead craft filmed on a table; code palette_size 19 at 2x is the quantised camera image, not the design's palette. The bead design itself is a cake slice in browns, reds, yellow cream, a red cherry and green leaves; darker brown beads for shadow.

lighting: Real daylight from a window on a grey counter; the bead design has its own baked light (top of cake lighter, side darker).
silhouette: Isometric cake slice with a cherry on top, clear wedge silhouette with a dark outline row of beads.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 33.3 ms, 28.03 changes/s (30 fps phone video with hands moving). Measured only the first 20 s of 49.41 s.

texture: Real plastic beads with visible holes, then ironed flat; blue gingham under-paper and white ironing paper.
camera: Top-down handheld phone, quick cuts between steps: tape, roll, peg-board, fill missing beads with tweezers, heat press, peel reveal.

acting.enters: The finished design is hinted in the first shot, then covered with tape.
acting.acts: Hands work through each craft step; a caption ('Filling in some missing parts') labels a step.
acting.exits: The design is hidden under paper during pressing.
acting.depth: Flat top-down; the reveal comes from peeling the paper back.

techniques: step-by-step process montage with short cuts
pixel design rendered in a physical medium (beads)
feel: NOT PIXEL ART: perler-bead craft process video; satisfying hands-on steps + hide-and-peel reveal = craft ASMR.
for_fred: Borrow the peel reveal: cover Fred or a result with a sheet/panel and have it slide or peel off on the beat, instead of animating him in yet again.
